about: The pieces of the grades' rule (Original road data, Profile from the original's screen), solved from the ROM zips by `npm run road-data -- screen-pieces`. Each piece is the changes of grade over its stretch, metres from the stretch's start, as road-profile's Change [from, to, change]; the grade is 0 at both ends but on a lap, whose grade at its start and end is its `grade`. Looks are rows of the original's 224, both ways, over the hill frames; levelLook the level road's.

originals.about: OUTRUN's and TURBO OUTRUN's height tables (TURBO OUTRUN's are OUTRUN's 225), each run alone on a level road; a held table (kinds 1 and 3) at a speed, km/h. A stretch starts at the camera's station when the car is where the table starts (6 m before it). Table 0 shows no hill.

ENDURO RACER's normal path's cycle (256 positions from P & 0xFF = 0) and each hill's stretch of whole cycles (from the cycle start at or before the hill's start; its length in cycles), read through its level camera at this game's focal length. A stretch starts at the camera's station when the road position is the stretch's first.

FINAL LAP 2's laps, each by its course's name: its screen round its second lap of three alike, read through its level camera at this game's focal length. A stretch starts at the camera's station when the car is at its table's start; the grade is 0 there and at its end, a lap later.

CISCO HEAT's stages' roads in parts, each by its stage, road and part: its road CPU's rows over the part, read through its camera tilting with the road at this game's focal length. A road is cut at both ends of each run of at least 200 m of the car whose screen shows no hill; a stretch starts at the camera's station when the car is at its part's start, the grade 0 there and at its end.
